words.description: The words to practise, in reading order, one entry per word or short phrase as written. Empty when nothing is readable.

confidence.description: How sure the answer is of the words overall, 0 (not at all) to 1 (certain).

notes.description: One plain sentence for the parent: any doubt, or why no words were read.

placed.description: Version 2 requests only: where each word sits on the spelling graph. One entry for each word in `words`, in the same order. Leave it out when the request listed no nodes.

node.description: The `id` of the one node in the request's `nodes` that this word practises. Leave it out when none of them fits.
